idea-plugin.name: WinScript Support
idea-plugin.description:
Out-of-the-box basic support for Windows scripts in IntelliJ Platform (2025.3+):
  • Syntax highlighting for Batch (.bat/.cmd) and PowerShell (.ps1): keywords, variables, strings, labels, here-strings, numbers, type expressions
  • Run configurations: Batch script, PowerShell script (pwsh preferred, falls back to powershell.exe), and arbitrary shell command
  • Run .bat/.ps1 directly from the editor context menu
  • Path macros ($ProjectFileDir$, $FileDir$, ...) in parameters and working directories
  • Lightweight error annotations: unclosed % variables, quotes, parentheses, block comments, here-strings
  • Configurable interpreters, console encoding and default execution policy
  • No external services required

  • 0.1.1 — Replace deprecated API usages flagged by Plugin Verifier (RunConfigurationProducer constructor, FileChooserDescriptorFactory); no functional changes.
  • 0.1.0 — Initial release: syntax highlighting for Batch/PowerShell, three run configuration types, context-menu run, path macros, error annotations, global settings.
